suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-16 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. The cited UK community study found DSM-5 hoarding disorder associated with elevated comorbid depressive and anxiety disorders in a population sample. Require independently established DSM-5 hoarding disorder and separately established depressive disorder; the cited community study reported elevated comorbidity of hoarding disorder with mood and anxiety disorders and does not establish onset order or direction. Preserve other psychiatric illness, substance use, medical illness, medications, shared vulnerability, and disorganization or collecting behavior attributable to other conditions as competing explanations. Do not infer a depressive disorder from hoarding-related distress or impairment alone, and do not treat this population-level association as proof that hoarding disorder caused an individual's depressive disorder. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
